maintenance.title: The Platform Is Temporarily Unavailable
maintenance.message:
We apologize for the inconvenience. The platform is currently unavailable due to scheduled maintenance and updates being carried out to improve performance and enhance your overall experience.

We appreciate your understanding, and access to the platform will be restored as soon as the maintenance work is completed.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
